ety.text: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *sъnęti, from *sъ(n)- (see *sъ(n)) + *ęti. Reanalyzed as с- (s-) + -нять (-njatʹ), from which other words in -нять (-njatʹ) were created, such as наня́ть (nanjátʹ), обня́ть (obnjátʹ).
